{{Quote|Stay on your guard. Death can strike anytime out here.|Grollix|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Grollix''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Outpost Zerek]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he asked a fellow Republic citizen to deal with invisible [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]].
